recent_en: RedPlanet transferred its listing from the LEAP Market to the ACE Market on 22 October 2026, with a public issue of 70 million new shares at RM0.19 each. In early November, the company announced a RM7.09 million systems integration contract for a 15MWac solar project in Sabah. Revenue for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 22% year-on-year to RM40.7 million.
notable_en: The company transferred its listing from the LEAP Market to the ACE Market on 22 October 2026, with a public issue of 70 million new shares at RM0.19 each.
The company secured a RM7.09 million systems integration contract for a 15MWac solar project in Sabah.
Revenue for the latest quarter rose 22% year-on-year to RM40.7 million.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Phong Hon Wai disposed of 50,000 shares on 26 October 2026 for RM13,500 in the open market.

Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their shareholdings in October 2026, including Dato' Steve Wan Siew Kum, Steve & Co Capital Sdn. Bhd., and Panjetty Kumaradevan Senthil Kumar.
Directors and the Chief Financial Officer declared intentions to deal during the closed period between October and November 2026.
